About Us

Gnanasekar Shell Lime Kilinjal Sunnambu

Gnanasekar Shell Lime Kilinjal Sunnambu is a shell lime powder and Kilinjal manufacturer and supplier based in Annanagar, Korukkupet, Chennai.

We have been serving customers since 1987. We take retail and wholesale enquiries, and our business is open every day from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
